claim: Stored composed Anthropic+Jev V4 responses are compared with a new local execution of the unchanged preexisting deterministic rules router on the exact same frozen examples and labels. This is not fresh current-AI validation.

audit.method: Independent static recalculation from all 40 retained per-case records; every expected intent checked against the frozen fixture and each stored AI result/provider count checked against the original V4 report. Module hashes checked against current bytes and the recorded pre-V4 Git snapshot. No application arm, API, database, private environment file or network request was executed during this audit.

method.routingInput: rulesRoute(item.text, { verified: true }); no pendingKind, lastSaid, pauseOffered, or conversation history
method.consentGuard: Return unclear with amountDollars 0 before rulesRoute or any provider when state.pendingKind is present, preserving the V4 code-only state gate. This is a shared gate check, not evidence of model value.
method.oracle: Unchanged fixture.routing[].intent. Every stored report expected label is checked against that oracle; consent expected is unclear under the original protocol.
method.scoring: Exact intent match and wrong non-unclear mutation routes, matching the original V4 contract. Amount outputs are retained and compared only diagnostically because V4 has no independent expected-amount labels. No amount oracle is derived from stored model output.
method.excludedAdditions: No new intent-clarity guard, pattern tuning, new examples, label edits, case exclusion, model rerun, or provider calls.
method.latency: Rules latency is a new local single-pass timing with millisecond rounding; AI latency is the historical report. These are descriptive, not controlled performance measurements.

preV4GitCommit.subject: feat: add guarded AI and durable sandbox checkout

localProjectModuleClosure.role: module-import-only via say.js; no cover function is called by rulesRoute or asksForAmount

sourceProvenance.limitation: Recorded V4 AI outputs are reused. Current agent.js and gate.js differ from the V4 manifest. The original manifest omitted numbers.js and cover.js; numbers matches pre-run Git, while changed cover.js is an import-only dependency. Full V4 import-closure identity is not established. Dependency manifests match V4; the installed vendor tree is not separately frozen.

limits: Retrospective analysis of a small synthetic developer-curated fixture; no fresh, blind, independent, or production-generalization claim is supported.

V4 fixture authors used canonical definitions in router.js. The protocol documents blinding from prior fixtures/results and the current intent guard; it does not establish that fixture authors were blind to all keyword rules in the same router.js file. Later analysis authors have seen historical outcomes.

The composed AI system includes deterministic guards, a Jev advisory route, and a rules-agreement quick path. This comparison estimates that whole recorded composition against existing raw keyword routing plus the shared pending-state gate; it cannot isolate the causal value of Anthropic or Jev alone.
Current agent.js and gate.js differ from V4 report hashes. No current AI execution occurred; the old stored AI outputs are reused exactly.
Amounts and empathy have no independent V4 fixture oracle. Equality of amounts does not establish correctness, and differences are not scored as errors.
No existing primary V4 report, older benchmark, failed goal benchmark, source file, fixture text, or label is replaced or altered by this supplementary analysis.
Wrong mutation-route counts measure proposed intent classification, not executed or prevented real payments. The historical comparison does not replace the failed fresh goal comparisons.
